hypothesis: K7-offcatalogue-relay-corridor: off-catalogue geothermal conduits occur at structural stepover/relay zones, not on catalogue-mapped traces; a binary structural-dot prior distributed along synthetic relay corridors with minimum spacing should capture hidden faults missed by catalogue-derived submissions (e.g. GEMSDOE32 H33-2-B2, claimed 0.2778).
mechanism: Coordinate-seeded pseudo-random field weighted by proximity to two synthetic structural corridors; rank-order threshold to a target dot count; grid-bucket non-maximum suppression enforcing 3 px minimum inter-dot spacing; no catalogue or training data used, so every dot is off-catalogue by construction.
non_fault_mimic: Any linear geomorphic or noise feature (drainage, road, image stripe, DEM artifact) that aligns with the synthetic corridors would be selected as a dot despite having no fault/geothermal fluid signal.
holdout_blocker: Competition data tab (training_features.tif, existing_faults.tif, labels.tif, sample_submission.tif) is DrivenData-login-gated; redirects to login. No holdout can be constructed without it.
lane_check: not performed (no registry raster available); LANE rule deferred until data access
leakage_canary: not applicable (no training/label data; no feature computed from labels)
note: K7 off-catalogue relay-corridor binary dots; unique vs all GEMSDOE sites; holdout-validated score pending data access.
uniqueness_basis: Different seed (0x4B37), dot count (10,944 actual vs 37,654 GEMSDOE32), minimum spacing (3.0 px vs 2.8 px), and NO catalogue-collar exclusion vs GEMSDOE32; distinct from every GEMSDOE24/25/27/28/30/31/32/33/36 artifact.
estimated_score: not measurable (projection forbidden by protocol); GEMSDOE32 claimed reference 0.2778 (owner/organizer-reported; some sources mark it unscored), public leaderboard #1 = 0.4413 (organizer-confirmed).
verdict_reason: Structurally valid and unique, but holdout DTI cannot be measured (login-gated data) and cannot be shown to beat the holdout best. Per protocol, do not spend a submission slot on an unvalidated idea. Promote only after (1) byte-conformance to sample_submission.tif grid and (2) holdout DTI beats current incumbent.
next_steps: Obtain DrivenData login access to the competition data tab
Conform raster byte-for-byte to sample_submission.tif CRS/shape/transform
Run holdout DTI (alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, 300 m triangular kernel) on spatially blocked holdout
